- `pilot.aeronautical_knowledge.recency`: Modelled as "through the last day of the 24th calendar month after the month of completion". Confirm calendar-month semantics against 14 CFR 1.1 and FAA guidance.

- `operation.max_groundspeed`: 87 kt is 44.757 m/s and 100 mph is 44.704 m/s; the lower value is used. Confirm.
